سَحِيلٌ : see سَحْلٌ, in three places. ＝
-A2- Also, and ↓ سُحَالٌ , [both mentioned above as inf. ns., (see 1, last sentence,)] The rolling sound in the chest of the ass: (S, K:) or the former, [and probably the latter also,] the most vehement braying of the wild ass. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
